description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionPersistenceActor class, which manages the lifecycle, state, and messaging for connection objects within a distributed system. It handles commands related to connection management, persists state, interacts with child actors for protocol-specific operations, and manages connection-specific logging, monitoring, and acknowledgments.

classes.name: ConnectionPersistenceActor
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and state persistence of a network connection, handling commands, interactions with child actors, logging, monitoring, and message routing for connections within a distributed environment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for initializing the ConnectionPersistenceActor with necessary configuration.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the persistence ID used for storing state in the persistence backend.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the journal plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the snapshot plugin used for persistence.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Handles post-recovery activities once the actor has finished recovering state, such as opening connections if needed.

methods.name: onMutation
methods.description: Processes incoming commands and applies state changes or staged commands accordingly.

methods.name: matchAnyAfterInitialization
methods.description: Defines message handlers for various signals and commands after actor initialization, including signal forwarding and management commands.

methods.name: interpretStagedCommand
methods.description: Executes each step in a sequence of staged commands related to connection management, such as testing, opening, closing, and logging.

methods.name: initializeAckLabelsDeclared
methods.description: Initializes acknowledgment label declaration state upon startup or connection change.

methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels with the remote connection if applicable.
